layout_contract.group: full module boundary, stretch rows, no phantom items
layout_contract.compact: only explicit data-qt-align=compact for justified local combination
layout_contract.capacity: wrappable font budget + intrinsic media ratio + actual parent; never rendered height feedback
layout_contract.media: qt-t-media-group aligns media slots/captions; screenshots contain + original size
layout_contract.review: Internal source records only in draft/refine review; no automatic public citations or audit footer. Reader-facing attribution is authored.

content_icons.family: original 24x24 viewBox / 1.8 stroke; 26px symbol / 44px tone plate; decorative alongside heading
content_icons.extension: assets/icons/content-<name>.svg, same proportions/style; add provenance fingerprint, no brand-logo imitation

typography.notice: Visual reading roles, independent of semantic heading depth; values are px. Generated CSS and browser checks read this one table. Utility/public shell and image-internal text are separate.

cluster.structure: primary + supporting cards/production; wrappers may use group or stack
cluster.alignment: Visible peer frames share a bottom only when presented side by side; sparse or overfull pairs reflow into continuous rows
cluster.capacity: Natural wrapping and intrinsic media; no authored card height. Add/delete/rewrite triggers recomposition.

fields.use: Same-role fields in peer cards, including variable-height preceding title/summary; names and order must correspond
fields.alignment: Measured natural field heights shared within a visible row; never across stacked cards

layout_contracts.detection: Visible frames remain checked in natural groups; discover unregistered content columns, sparse frame tails and full-width photo painted edges; field/anchor/baseline contracts remain explicit

anchors.use: Same-row corresponding starts; enforced in natural groups too; no automatic padding

baselines.use: Explicit cross-module horizontal edge only; different hierarchies use separate names

parallel.use: Author-defined content columns with visible peer boundaries; author CSS owns responsive layout, checker and field alignment still apply

production_contract.evidence: explicit claim/relation/basis; sequence identifies same subject/task/work
production_contract.review: separate semantic countercheck; no automatic truth/user acceptance

editorial_expression.font: 正文无衬线；标题或局部引言可选择本机衬线展示栈，回退不影响层级，不联网加载字体
editorial_expression.focus: 先确定读者要做什么/得到什么，方法提醒与检查建议为支持内容；颜色与表面强化该主次
editorial_expression.boundary: 无固定图标/贴片数量；长文/条件不强行拆卡；技术与视觉判断分开

reading_contract.navigation: page-navigation/stage-navigation use real fragment anchors; every section remains in DOM and mobile adds no second sticky bar
reading_contract.title: qt-t-title-phrase + 320px preview; manual semantic line review
reading_contract.mixed_panels: data-qt-align=natural preserves intrinsic media only; parallel visible frames and same-role fields remain aligned; sparse evidence reflows
reading_contract.media_order: data-qt-fit=media with data-qt-reading=text-first only when the first child is media
reading_contract.focus: Normalized reading position survives fit/original, manual scrolling and resize; explicit focus resets; each image initializes independently
reading_contract.profiles: preview is partial; full covers all modules/media/buttons and declared widths
reading_contract.outcome: production_status + purpose-scoped business_information + exact-HTML user_acceptance; completion needs all three
reading_contract.custom_columns: data-qt-composition=parallel checks authored peer boundaries without replacing author CSS; undeclared content columns fail
reading_contract.photo_columns: qt-t-photo-column preserves full-width natural photographs; same-column photo painted edges are checked
